note: Every player of Madden NFL 12's launch roster (the 2011 season) as [name, EA team id, Madden position, overall], read by npm run sync:madden-seasons from the sources scripts/data/nfl-seasons.json pins; npm run build:nfl-seasons builds the season from it.

source.iteration: original roster (the default roster, rated before the 2011 lockout ended)
remarks: Madden NFL 12's original roster is the game's default roster, rated before the 2011 lockout ended: many players are still with their 2010 teams (Kevin Kolb an Eagle, Matt Hasselbeck a Seahawk, Nnamdi Asomugha a Raider). maddenratings.net keeps no later full roster.
